subject: English
passage: Mutualism, the relationship in which two species each benefit from their interaction, has important consequences for many ecosystems. For instance, it can help crops absorb nutrients from poor soils. To develop a treatment that maximizes nutrient uptake, Michael Mercer and Ignacio Pena coated wheat seedlings with mycorrhizal fungi that wrap around root tips. Absorption of phosphorus by roots paired with these fungi is generally quite high, and when the researchers also introduced a strain of soil bacteria, that absorption rose even further. This combined treatment may substantially improve yields on nutrient-depleted farmland.
prompt: According to the text, what happened when the researchers introduced soil bacteria to the wheat seedlings coated with mycorrhizal fungi?

choices.A: All of the mycorrhizal fungi migrated to a single seedling.
choices.B: The high level of phosphorus absorption by the roots became even higher.
choices.C: The mycorrhizal fungi began to wrap around the root tips of the seedlings.
choices.D: Phosphorus absorption by the roots did not noticeably change at first.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer because it accurately describes what happened when soil bacteria were introduced to the wheat seedlings coated with mycorrhizal fungi. The text states that phosphorus absorption by roots paired with these fungi is generally quite high, and when the researchers also introduced a strain of soil bacteria, that absorption rose even further. This indicates that the already high level of absorption became even higher.
